TCL Expands TAB A1 Tablet Lineup with New 11-Inch Models

by Eddie Chim31 August 2026046
Discover more
Using Online Calculators
display
processor
Share00
TCL, one of the world’s best-selling consumer electronics brands, today announced the expansion of its TAB A1 tablet portfolio with the TCL TAB A1 NXTPAPER and TCL TAB A1. The new 11-inch models complete TCL’s TAB A1 family, giving consumers more choice across two screen sizes and two viewing experiences, including TCL’s NXTPAPER display technology.

Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:13
Instaread

The TAB A1 series balances screen size, portability, and display comfort for everyday use.

TCL TAB A1 NXTPAPER: Paper-Like Comfort for Work, Study and Play
The TCL TAB A1 NXTPAPER pairs the portability of an 11-inch tablet with TCL’s latest NXTPAPER 3A Crystal technology, for a more comfortable viewing experience during extended screen time.

Key features of the TCL TAB A1 NXTPAPER:

  • 6 GB RAM + 128 GB storage for apps, files, and entertainment
  • 8000 mAh battery with 20 W charging
  • Ultra-slim 0.24-inch design and lightweight 0.94lb body for portability
  • MediaTek Helio G100 processor for dependable everyday performance
  • Google Gemini and AI tools for productivity
  • Included T-Pen 2 for writing, note-taking, annotating, and sketching
  • Included Flipcase for added protection
  • 5MP front camera for video calls and 8MP rear camera for content capture

TCL TAB A1: Lightweight Entertainment Wherever You Go
The TCL TAB A1 is made for those who want big-screen entertainment in a device that is easy to carry. Its 11-inch 2.1K display and smooth 90 Hz refresh rate deliver crisp, vibrant visuals, while the ultra-slim 0.24-inch design makes it easy to take on the go.

Key features of the TCL TAB A1:

  • 6 GB RAM + 128 GB storage for apps, streaming, browsing
  • 8000mAh battery with 20 W charging
  • Ultra-slim 0.24-inch design and lightweight 0.95lb body for portability
  • MediaTek Helio G100 processor for reliable everyday performance
  • Quad stereo speakers for immersive sounds
  • 5MP front camera for video calls and 8MP rear camera for content capture

More Screen Options, More Ways to Use Them
By combining reliable performance with TCL’s display expertise, the TAB A1 series gives consumers the flexibility to stream, work, study and read, all within an accessible tablet lineup.

With the TAB A1 portfolio complete, consumers can choose between two form factors, as well as standard and NXTPAPER display options. The TAB A1 Plus series delivers TCL’s largest tablet experience with immersive 12.2-inch displays, while the new 11-inch TAB A1 models offer a slimmer, more portable design for everyday use.

The TCL TAB A1 NXTPAPER is available now on Amazon or TCL.com at $249.99, and TAB A1 is available now on Amazon or TCL.com at $189.99.

Source: TCL
